mapper.select:
SELECT o.order_id, o.order_no, o.order_name, o.customer_name, o.dept_id, o.owner_user_id, o.amount, o.status, o.remark, o.create_time FROM biz_order o
AND o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{orderNo}, '%')
AND o.order_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{orderName}, '%')
AND o.status = #{status}
ORDER BY o.order_id ASC
SELECT o.order_id, o.order_no, o.order_name, o.customer_name, o.dept_id, o.owner_user_id, o.amount, o.status, o.remark, o.create_time FROM biz_order o WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_order (order_no, order_name, customer_name, dept_id, owner_user_id, amount, status, remark) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{orderName}, #{customerName}, #{deptId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{remark})
